claim_being_audited: That certifying the model for rollout is compliant and adequately supported because aggregate readiness passed, monitoring and rollback controls exist, and the remaining health-plan benefits support weakness can be handled through limited-basis certification with disclosure.
decision_criteria: Certification can be compliant if admissible evidence shows the material limitation is explicitly disclosed for the exposed named launch use case in the final model-card or launch materials.
Certification can be compliant if admissible evidence shows the affected use case is excluded from rollout exposure.
Certification can be compliant if admissible evidence shows reviewed and approved risk acceptance specifically covering the exposed health-plan benefits support segment.
Absent one of those links, aggregate readiness, monitoring, rollback, and a small rollout percentage are insufficient under the stated policy.
evidence_requests: Provide the final approved model-card or launch disclosure showing the health-plan benefits support limitation is explicitly disclosed for the named use case.
Provide reviewed and approved risk acceptance that specifically addresses continued exposure of the health-plan benefits support segment, if certification is being justified without exclusion.
Provide rollout configuration evidence showing the affected use case is excluded from exposure, if that is the mitigation being claimed.
Provide the exact release-approval record tying certification to the disclosure or risk-acceptance basis.
specific_concerns: The actor summary itself says the affected health-plan benefits support segment remains below target and remains exposed in the initial rollout cohort.

The governing policy states rollout controls and monitoring are not sufficient when the affected use case remains exposed unless the rollout excludes that use case or there is reviewed risk acceptance.
No approved or reviewed risk acceptance covering the exposed health-plan benefits support use case is in evidence.
No admissible evidence is provided showing the required model-card disclosure was actually completed and approved for the named launch use case.
The actor's justification risks overstating what aggregate readiness and rollback controls prove relative to the unresolved use-case-specific disclosure predicate.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the existing record rather than only potentially supportable after documented disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
That rollout controls, small initial percentage, or reversibility materially cure the model-card weakness while the affected segment remains exposed.
That the packet contains the required disclosure basis for the named launch use case.
